proposed_comments.title: Revalidate package content before launch
proposed_comments.body:
### Revalidate package content before launch

**Severity:** `high`

This currentness check revalidates the package identity and metadata, but a previously verified package can still be modified or tampered with after the initial `VerifyContentIntegrityAsync` call and before launch. Re-run content-integrity verification for previously verified targets using the resolved package, fail closed when that package is unavailable, and retain the package handle in the registration returned by the resolver.

confidence.rationale: The currentness path does not repeat the content-integrity check; the exact upstream candidate builds after retaining and revalidating the resolved package.

proposed_comments.title: Drain thread-pool I/O before pipe teardown
proposed_comments.body:
### Drain thread-pool I/O before pipe teardown

**Severity:** `high`

`Close` cancels outstanding I/O and immediately releases `Connection`. A pending completion can release the final reference from inside `CompleteIo`, destroying the connection while its callback is still active and closing the thread-pool I/O and pipe before callbacks drain. Cancel the operations, wait for all thread-pool I/O callbacks to finish, then close the thread-pool I/O and pipe before releasing the owning connection.

confidence.rationale: The current teardown can destroy callback-owned resources while a completion is active; the exact candidate builds after explicitly draining callbacks.
